context: Wrote implementation plan for plugin hygiene fixes at docs/superpowers/plans/2026-04-29-plugin-hygiene.md. 25 tasks across 7 phases.
rationale: Chose to phase the work as: verifications first → test helper → server gate → simple hook guards → ensure-claude-md-gates (compound changes) → SessionStart command hook → versions → manual smoke test → release. Foundation-first ordering means each phase's tests can rely on infrastructure from prior phases.
